nodes.html:
Defining your

LumApps Analytics

Use Cases

ADC’s knowledge of LumApps’ product, best practices and customer use cases allows us to better collaborate with our customers to define, refine and execute on creating a meaningful Analytics experience dashboard with the right data for the right user.
Delivering Customized Analytics Experience Dashboard(s)

There are many ways of telling your analytics story. Sometimes the data is readily available in one source, and sometimes it takes a bit of creative inputs to pull the right data out of the right sources. Our team pulls the right data and serves it up in the right way to enhance your analytics dashboard

Connect multiple data sources with your BI

Tools
We can integrate and blend any data together, provided that it is available, and serve it up in a BI tool of your choice. Whether it’s with Looker Data Studio, Tableau or other tools on the market.

c.html: OUR APPROACH

Our Analytics Implementation

Methodology

Define

Identifying Analytics Use Cases

The “Define” phase is a series of working sessions aimed at discovering the type of data required to be collected, data sources, and defining the audience

Integrate

Connecting the Right Data Sources

Following a Define sessions, we will work on connecting the data to the data points. This could be as simple as setting up GTM Tags, connecting to BQ, or extracting custom data

Design

Telling Your Analytics Experience Story

Visualize the data in the BI tool by creating engaging and clean dashboards in the BI tool of choice. The dashboards are customized based on the predefined use case

Deliver

Bringing it All

Together

Once the Dashboard has been designed and tested it will be delivered for review and customer approval.
